title: Pay via GCash
content: Pay your ACME postpaid or fiber bill using GCash. Open the GCash app, tap 'Pay Bills', select 'Telecommunications', then 'ACME Telecom'. Enter your ACME account number (found on your bill or in the ACME app under Account > Account Details) and the amount to pay. Confirm with your GCash MPIN. Payment is credited within 1 hour. You can also buy ACME prepaid load through GCash: tap 'Buy Load', enter the ACME number, and select the amount. No transaction fee for bill payments up to PHP 10,000. GCash charges PHP 15 for amounts above PHP 10,000.

metadata.fee: Free for up to PHP 10,000; PHP 15 for amounts above

title: Pay via Maya (PayMaya)
content: Pay your ACME bill using the Maya app (formerly PayMaya). Open Maya, go to 'Pay Bills', search for 'ACME Telecom', enter your account number, and the payment amount. Confirm with your Maya PIN or biometrics. Payment reflects within 1-2 hours. You can also purchase prepaid load: tap 'Load', enter the ACME number and amount. Maya accepts funding from linked bank accounts, credit/debit cards, and Maya wallet balance. No service fee for bill payments. For load purchases, a PHP 1 convenience fee applies per transaction.

metadata.fee: Free for bill payments; PHP 1 per load purchase

title: Pay via Bank Transfer (BDO, BPI)
content: Pay your ACME bill through online banking with BDO or BPI. For BDO: Log in to BDO Online or the BDO app, go to 'Bills Payment', select 'Telecommunications' > 'ACME Telecom', enter your ACME account number, and the amount. For BPI: Log in to BPI Online or the BPI app, go to 'Pay Bills', add 'ACME Telecom' as a biller, enter your account number, and pay. Other banks (Metrobank, UnionBank, RCBC, Security Bank) can also process ACME payments through their bills payment portals — search for 'ACME Telecom' under telecom billers. Bank transfers typically reflect within 1-2 business days. Keep the transaction reference number as confirmation.

metadata.channel: Bank Transfer (BDO, BPI, and major banks)

title: Pay at 7-Eleven (Cliqq)
content: Pay your ACME bill or buy prepaid load at any 7-Eleven branch nationwide using the Cliqq kiosk or over the counter. Using the Cliqq kiosk: Tap 'Bills Payment', select 'ACME Telecom', enter your account number and amount, the machine prints a payment slip, bring the slip to the cashier, and pay in cash. Over-the-counter: Tell the cashier you want to pay your ACME bill or buy ACME load. Provide your account number or mobile number. Pay in cash. You will receive a receipt. Keep the receipt as proof of payment. Bill payments reflect within 24 hours. Load purchases are credited instantly. Available at all 3,000+ 7-Eleven branches nationwide. A PHP 10 convenience fee applies per transaction.

metadata.processingTime: Load: instant; Bill payment: within 24 hours

title: Pay at SM Bills Payment
content: Pay your ACME bill at SM Bills Payment counters located inside SM Supermalls, SM Hypermarkets, and SaveMore stores. Go to the SM Bills Payment counter (usually near the customer service area or business center). Fill out a ACME payment form with your account number and amount. Pay in cash. Receive a machine-validated receipt. Payment reflects within 1-2 business days. Available at all SM retail locations nationwide during mall hours. A PHP 15 service fee applies per transaction. Maximum single transaction amount is PHP 50,000.

title: Pay at Bayad Center
content: Pay your ACME postpaid or fiber bill at any Bayad Center outlet. Bayad Center has over 47,000 payment locations nationwide including standalone Bayad Centers, authorized agent outlets, and partner locations (rural banks, cooperatives, pawnshops). Visit any Bayad Center location. Tell the teller you want to pay your ACME bill. Provide your ACME account number and name on account. Pay in cash. You will receive a printed receipt as proof of payment. Payment reflects within 1-2 business days. You can also pay through the Bayad app: download from the App Store or Google Play, register, and select 'ACME Telecom' under billers. A PHP 12 convenience fee applies per over-the-counter transaction. Bayad app payments are free of charge.

metadata.fee: PHP 12 per OTC transaction; free via Bayad app

title: Auto-Debit (Bank Account or Credit Card)
content: Set up automatic monthly payments so you never miss a due date. Enroll through the ACME app: go to Billing > Auto-Pay > Set Up Auto-Debit. Supported bank accounts: BDO, BPI, Metrobank, UnionBank, Security Bank, and RCBC (savings or checking). Supported credit/debit cards: Visa and Mastercard issued by any Philippine bank. Enter your account or card details and authorize the recurring debit. Auto-debit processes on the 13th of each month (2 days before the due date). The exact bill amount is debited — no rounding or estimates. You receive an SMS notification before and after each auto-debit. To modify or cancel, go to the same menu in the app. Changes take effect the following billing cycle. No fees for auto-debit enrollment or transactions. If auto-debit fails (insufficient funds, expired card), you receive an SMS alert and must pay manually before the due date to avoid late fees.

title: Pay at ACME Stores
content: Pay your ACME bill directly at any of the 10 ACME stores nationwide. Accepted payment methods at stores: cash, credit/debit card (Visa, Mastercard, JCB), ACMEPay QR, GCash QR, and Maya QR. Simply visit the store during operating hours and proceed to the billing counter. Provide your ACME account number or registered mobile number. Payment reflects immediately for in-store transactions. You can also buy prepaid load, subscribe to promos, and manage your account during the same visit. No additional fees for in-store payments. Stores also accept advance payments (pay multiple months ahead). Receipt is issued for all transactions. Store hours are typically 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily — check specific store hours at airgap.dev/stores.
